question: Which climate zone is characterised by hot and humid conditions throughout the year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tropical climate zones are characterized by **hot and humid conditions throughout the year**.
 
• They are located near the **Equator**, between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn.
 
• These regions receive a high amount of solar radiation, resulting in consistently warm temperatures and **minimal seasonal variation.**
 
• Tropical zones experience **significant rainfall** due to their proximity to Intertropical Convergence Zones (ITCZ), which facilitates frequent precipitation.
 
• Examples of tropical climates include the **Amazon rainforest**, the Congo Basin, and Southeast Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)**

 
 
• A region near the Equator where **trade winds converge**, leading to frequent thunderstorms and heavy rainfall.
 
• The ITCZ shifts seasonally, influencing precipitation patterns in tropical regions.
 
 
 
• **Rainforest Ecosystem**
 
 
• Tropical rainforests are characterized by **high biodiversity**, with millions of species of plants, animals, and microorganisms.
 
• They serve as the **Earth's lungs** by producing oxygen and absorbing carbon dioxide.
 
 
 
• **Temperature Range**
 
 
• In tropical climates, the average monthly temperature typically stays above **18°C (64°F)** year-round.
 
• This contrasts with other climate zones where seasonal temperature variations are more pronounced.
 
 
 
• **Subtypes of Tropical Climate**
 
 
• **Tropical rainforest climate:** High rainfall throughout the year.
 
• **Tropical monsoon climate:** Seasonal shifts between wet and dry periods.
 
• **Tropical savanna climate:** Wet summers and dry winters.
